history.note: Initial detection in noisy field; possible point source.

last_action_reasoning: Initial analysis of the difference image shows significant noise and subtraction artifacts, particularly around the bright star in the lower-left quadrant and its diffraction spikes. However, a potential transient candidate (CAND_01) has been identified at (658, 852). This source appears as a faint point in the current observation but is absent from the reference image. Given the 15.7% cloud extinction and the noisy background, a second observation is necessary to confirm the source and rule out a cosmic ray or transient noise event.
